moments.author: Optimizely
moments.quote: Optimizely identified and contained a security incident; vulnerable path blocked and injected code removed.
moments.why: A massive supply‑chain malware incident hitting 178 major websites is dominating tech conversations.

moments.author: AGTP Insights
moments.quote: Scott Helme exposed a supply‑chain attack via Optimizely affecting Zoom, BBC, HSBC, IKEA, others — called it staggering.
moments.why: The staggering scale of the breach is sparking alarm among tech‑savvy men.

moments.author: AP News
moments.quote: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang signals interest in returning to lead the company.
moments.why: Huang’s potential comeback amid scandal is fueling AI and business‑world chatter.

moments.author: Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney
moments.quote: Nvidia CEO stepping down amid affair allegations marks "a sad day" for "all humanity."
moments.why: A strong reaction from a major tech figure gives emotional weight to the unfolding executive drama.

moments.author: New York Post (via YTN report)
moments.quote: Huang allegedly yelled "I hope you die" and threw a water bottle at an executive.
moments.why: Shocking conduct allegations about a high‑profile tech CEO have gone viral internationally.
